en.text:
Modifies <solar/>Golden Gun to only fire a single shot that deals 650% increased damage and triggers an immediate <solar/>Ignition.

The triggered <solar/>Ignition overrides base <solar/>Scorch sources and solely benefits from damage increases to the <solar/>Golden Gun.

(A Celestial Nighthawk Precision Hit is ~85% more damage compared to 3 Precision Hits with Marksman Golden Gun. Also, please only use it with Marksman Golden Gun in PvE)

Scoring a <solar/>Golden Gun Kill refunds 33% Super Energy and causes the enemy to explode, dealing up to <pve 400 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a ? meter radius.

Precision Kills grant 1.5-4.5% Super Energy depending on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />.

<solar/>Golden Gun no longer receives faster active super generation as a roaming-class super.
